column1: # extras layer — what install.sh writes for this layer.
# One line per entry, TAB-separated:  mode<TAB>src<TAB>dest
#   mode  copy | tree | block | json | post
#   src   path relative to this directory
#   dest  path relative to $HOME (no leading / or ~, no ..); "-" for post
# Session 2: licence-checked Ghostty shaders (all off by default) and a tmuxinator template.
# Session 5: the project launcher (camp), sourced from ~/.zshrc by its own marked block, and the
# persona and voice starters (blank, kit-owned; the user copies them to ~/.claude/palmface-local/).
